Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact
 The Intel GPU Compiler Team develops the compiler technologies that unlock the performance, scalability, and efficiency of Intel's next-generation graphics and accelerated computing platforms. We are a highly collaborative team of compiler engineers, hardware architects, and software developers dedicated to delivering industry-leading experiences across gaming, artificial intelligence, visualization, and high-performance computing workloads.

 As a GPU Compiler Software Engineer, you will design and develop advanced compiler technologies that enable the capabilities of current and future Intel GPUs. You will play a key role in translating innovative hardware features into high-performance software solutions and helping shape the future of Intel's graphics and accelerated computing roadmap.  

 This position offers the opportunity to work across the hardware and software stack, influence next-generation GPU architecture, and solve some of the industry's most challenging compiler optimization problems.

 About the Business Group 
 The Data Center Group (DCG) develops leading-edge computing, networking, and acceleration technologies that power modern cloud infrastructure and data centers worldwide. Through continuous innovation in hardware and software, DCG delivers solutions that enable customers to process, analyze, and extract value from increasingly complex workloads while shaping the future of computing.

 Key responsibilities will include but not limited to: 
 Design and develop state of the art compiler translations and optimizations targeting GPUs.
 Investigate and prototype new optimizations to improve performance and efficiency for GPU systems.
 Collaborate with GPU HW architects to co-design/define new uArch features and ISA for future Intel GPUs.
 Performance measurement and workload analysis to evaluate and improve the compilation technology on new HW features.
 Write technical specification, design documents, and patent disclosures.
 
  Behavioral traits that we are looking for: 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to tackle highly complex technical challenges.
 Intellectual curiosity and a passion for understanding how software and hardware interact to deliver performance.
 Ability to navigate ambiguity and independently drive solutions from concept through implementation.
 Strong collaboration skills and effectiveness in working across geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
 Ownership mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
 Attention to detail and persistence when debugging difficult compiler, system, or performance issues.
 Continuous learning mindset and enthusiasm for emerging technologies in graphics, AI, compiler technology, and accelerated computing.
 
 Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 
 ·      See  Intel Benefits  for more details. 
 
 
 Qualifications: 
 You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.  Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research.
   
 Note: 
 For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see 
 Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information 
   
 Minimum Qualifications and Experience :
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field with 5+ years of relevant experience; OR 
 Master's degree in the same filed with 3+ years of relevant experience; OR 
 PhD in the same filed with 1+ of educational or relevant experience required.
 Your experience described above must be in the following:
 C/C++ programming skills supported by work experience on industry projects using these languages.
 Hardware/software interaction and low-level programming concepts.
 Experience in compiler development, compiler optimization, or code generation.
  
 Preferred Qualifications and Experience : (these are skills that are “nice to have” that are negotiable and if they don’t have them it’s not a show stopper).
 Knowledge of LLVM compiler internals and/or GPU compiler technology supported by professional experience in the domain.
 Familiarity with GPU Programming Models and 3D rendering pipeline using 3D/Compute APIs e.g.
 DirectX, Vulkan, OpenGL, OpenCL, etc.
 Experience with analysis and tuning of compiler transformations and optimizations.
 Design and development of a product compiler, e.g. in transformations, dataflow/control-flow/dependence analysis, optimizations, and code generation.
 Hands-on development of compiler tools, such as assembler, linker, debugger, etc.
 Experience with performance monitoring and HW considerations that can affect measuring methodologies.
 Experience contributing to language and standards groups or open-source compiler projects.
 Experience in using software development infrastructure - GitHub, JIRA, cmake, scripting languages.
 
 Why Join Intel 
 At Intel, you'll help shape the future of GPU and accelerated computing technologies. You'll work alongside industry-leading engineers, influence next-generation architectures, and contribute to solutions powering gaming, AI, cloud, and high-performance computing workloads worldwide.
  
 
           
 
 
 Job Type:
Experienced Hire 
 
 Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America) 
 
 Primary Location: 
US, California, Folsom 
 
 Additional Locations:
 
 
 
 
 Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. 
 Position of Trust
N/A 
 Benefits
 
 We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . 
  
  
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $149,600.00-211,200.00 USD  
  
The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process.  
  
 
 Work Model for this Role 
This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. 
 *
 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.
